business truth

first buyable productThe wall socket (tomada) is the first product sold online: stocked, packed, only choice is core colour black, red or white.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
made to orderMost pieces are made to order: client picks wood, finish and fabric; ~120 days to produce. No broad stock.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
site roleSite launches as a catalog first, not a full sales channel for furniture.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
stackShopify (built by an external studio), Pagar.me payments, shipping calculator integrated, WhatsApp hand-off for made-to-order pieces.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)

customer audience

architectsArchitects are a key audience and referrer; they will download 2D/3D blocks in exchange for an email.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
end clientEnd clients buying high-ticket pieces want a human conversation (wood, fabric, origin, lead time) before buying.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)

positioning

brand as institutionStrengthen More as a brand/institution, not as the story of one designer; people behind it may appear but are not the narrative.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
not tied to atelierDo not tie the More origin story to the atelier.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)

photography

ambient selectiveAmbient/in-project photos only when the project is aesthetically aligned; Instagram is the looser channel for them.
call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
no ai alteration of pieces lockedAI must never alter the piece itself; finish-swap imagery is phase 2/3 and must be exact.
